highlighted: Unlisting stops new rental contracts from being created, but it does not end existing contracts. Deleting or recreating a machine should only happen after active commitments and stored workloads are understood. Recreating may be useful after a failed install, stale record, or major hardware change, but do not use undocumented reset or recovery flags unless Vast support specifically instructs you to do so.
